items.gate_reason: The boundary rules explicitly place 'amounts-to' and flat equivalence of the terms themselves into archetypal-identity, not correspondence.
The 'is-a' relation assigning a concept to the class of archetypes is plain taxonomy (classification), not a part-whole composition.
The subject (Mercurius) is the less formulable term showing itself under a guise (serpent), which matches the directionality test for manifestation, not symbolization.
The edge is explicitly tagged with the amplification layer, which overrides the surface string according to the boundary rules.

The directionality test for manifestation requires the subject to be the less formulable term, but here the subject (rex) is the image symbolizing the less formulable term (arcane-substance), which is symbolization.
The relation 'signifies' with the image as the subject and the less formulable term as the object fits symbolization, whereas manifestation would require the inverted direction.
The quote asserts bare temporal order ('older than') without stating a requirement or condition, which places it in sequence rather than dependence.
The relation 'symbolized-by' is the declared inverse of 'symbolizes' and belongs to the symbolization family, not manifestation.
The quote describes an act of envisaging/predication by a named author (Jakob Böhme), not a temporal sequence.
The relation 'amplified-by' and the presence of the amplification layer tag strictly place this edge in the amplification family, not telos.
The edge explicitly asserts a lack or negated capacity (evil as a mere diminution of good), which is the exact seed for the privation family, not projection.
The text asserts a structural likeness or correspondence between their positions, not a familial or consort role.
The relation 'symbolizes' where the subject is the image and the object is the less formulable term is the definition of symbolization, not correspondence.
The quote explicitly frames the relation as an act of interpretation by a named tradition ('interpreted alchemically as'), which outranks the surface verb per the boundary rules.
Asserting that a concept is an archetype is a taxonomic 'is-a' relation, which belongs to classification, not correspondence.
This exact edge is explicitly listed as a seed for the union family, and the quote describes the accomplishment of the 'unitio'.
The relation 'coincides-with' is explicitly listed as a seed string for correspondence, asserting structural or temporal alignment.
The edge carries the 'amplification' layer tag and uses the 'amplified-by' relation, which is the definitional core of the amplification family.
The transmission or descent of a form or idea from an earlier one perfectly fits the definition of derivation, so a refusal is unjustified.

threshold: PASS = every planted item caught with the correct family named (should_be == was) and every class at quota; one miss or misdiagnosis in any class = FAIL. Set 2026-08-12 before the run (RULES #11). Specificity is reported, never gating.
